The pullback has reached the 0.618–0.786 zone of that advance (+12% to −8.7%), on lighter volume, with the 50-week average and the Oct 23, 2023 low in the same place. It is the second wave of a larger wave 3: five waves up from Mar 27, 2017 to Nov 8, 2021 and a pullback of 0.80 of them to the Dec 19, 2022 low came first, so the end of this wave 2 starts wave 3 of 3, the strongest move a chart makes. The count is wrong under the start of wave 1 (−35%); a close over the wave-1 high (+89%) says wave 3 is under way.
